The exact same warm brown beaver ranger as reference: green leaf-pattern hooded cape with gold leaf clasp, cream tunic, brown leather satchel, pinecone pouch, broad crosshatched flat tail, wooden Y-shaped slingshot. Preserve which anatomical hand holds the slingshot; never mirror.
Create 16 DISTINCT animation sprites arranged exactly 4 columns and 4 rows. Each row is the SAME action viewed in one fixed direction. Row 1 DOWN: front facing toward the lower screen edge. Row 2 RIGHT: nose faces right. Row 3 UP: back faces viewer, no front face visible. Row 4 LEFT: nose faces left. Every row contains 4 chronological frames from left to right. Draw all four directions independently; no horizontal mirroring.
Animation: Four-frame seamless scurrying walk cycle in place, alternating short foot steps and subtle tail sway, slingshot held safely at chest height; frame 4 transitions naturally into frame 1.
Warm hand-painted woodland storybook rendering, softly shaded watercolor-like materials with crisp readable outline, fixed elevated three-quarter orthographic game camera, upper-left light. Keep body size, anatomy, outfit, items and floor contact point consistent across frames. Pose changes must be actual limb/joint motion, not a static sprite rotated, tinted, squashed or translated. No camera or character-facing rotation within a row.
Use evenly spaced grid cells and generous true-transparent gutters. Entire sprite, tail, antennae and any local fragments must stay inside its own cell with at least 12% margin. Never overlap adjacent sprites.
Background must be TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha-zero PNG, not black, white, brown, a painted checkerboard or scenery. No floor, scenery, cast shadow, text, labels, numbers, borders, grid lines, UI, targets, enemies or watermark. No red damage flash, white hit outline, blood or gore. Keep particles minimal and attached/close to the main sprite.
